ctgov.note: Active studies: COMFORT Toddlers (NCT07003919, RECRUITING) and VITESSE (NCT05741476, ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING).

indications.indication: Peanut allergy in children ages 1-3 years (toddlers)
indications.highest_phase: Phase 3 (BLA-enabling under FDA Accelerated Approval pathway; BLA submission planned)
indications.trial_name: COMFORT Toddlers (supplemental safety study) + EPITOPE Phase 3 (efficacy, completed positive 2022) + EPOPEX (open-label extension, ongoing through Year 3 readout Jan 2025)
indications.trial_design: COMFORT Toddlers: open-label supplemental safety study aiming for ~300-350 subjects on active treatment using cVP (original square) Viaskin Peanut patch, to bring total active-treatment safety database to ~600 when combined with EPITOPE.
indications.trial_status: RECRUITING (first subject screened June 25, 2025); supports BLA submission under Accelerated Approval pathway; primary completion Nov 2026.
key_milestones: EPITOPE Phase 3 positive topline June 2022 (67% vs 33.5% responders)
EPOPEX Year 3 results January 2025 (83.5% reaching ED >=1000 mg)
FDA Accelerated Approval pathway alignment Dec 2024
COMFORT Toddlers first patient screened June 2025

indications.indication: Peanut allergy in children ages 4-7 years
indications.trial_name: VITESSE (Viaskin Peanut Immunotherapy Trial to Evaluate Safety, Simplicity and Efficacy)
indications.trial_design: Phase 3 pivotal randomized 2:1 active to placebo, modified circular Viaskin Peanut (mVP) patch 250 mcg vs placebo, daily for 12 months, primary endpoint = percentage of treatment responders at month 12; n=654 enrolled.
indications.trial_status: ACTIVE_NOT_RECRUITING (screening completed Q3 2024; primary completion Nov 2025); open-label extension ongoing.

indications.trial_design: Phase 1/2 efficacy and safety study of Viaskin Milk patch in children with IgE-mediated cow's milk allergy.
indications.trial_status: Listed as ongoing program in 10-K Phase 2; ctgov shows COMPLETED for the original MILES study (NCT02223182). Next-stage MILES program disclosed as planned in 10-K pipeline table.

indications.trial_design: Planned Phase 2 study of Viaskin Milk patch for EoE in pediatric patients.
indications.trial_status: PLANNED - listed in 10-K pipeline table under Phase 2 ongoing/planned column for EoE; no NCT identifier yet.

excluded_legacy_terminated: PEPITES (Phase 3 in 4-11 yr olds, NCT02636699) - completed but program superseded by VITESSE in 4-7 yr olds.
PEOPLE / EPITOPE original (NCT03211247) - completed; ongoing OLE = EPOPEX (NCT03859700) is COMPLETED in ctgov.
Viaskin Pertussis Vaccine (NCT03035370) - completed Phase 1, no further development disclosed.
DBV1605 diagnostic for non-IgE CMA (NCT04492683) - status UNKNOWN.

summary_counts.note: Counts by indication: 2 Phase 3 (Viaskin Peanut toddler + 4-7 yr) + 2 Phase 2 (Viaskin Milk CMA + EoE).
